sources.title: Woman shot dead by police in Jamaica at protest over previous police shooting
sources.excerpt: during a protest in Granville, St James, against a police shooting days earlier
sources.provenance: The Guardian, directly opened; initial report published May 19. The report describes the protest and fatal shooting of Latoya Bulgin on May 17, citing the Independent Commission of Investigations (Indecom).

sources.title: Jamaican police officer charged with murder after woman shot during protest
sources.excerpt: The killing of Latoya “Buju” Bulgin on 17 May
sources.provenance: The Guardian follow-up, directly opened; says officer was charged after the fatal shooting and gives the earlier protest context. Used to corroborate event date; it is published after the event.

provisional_leads.assessment: A clearly dated public protest is documented, prompted by an earlier police shooting of 17-year-old Tjey Edwards; reporting says a woman, Latoya Bulgin, was fatally shot during the May 17 demonstration, and that an officer was subsequently charged.
provisional_leads.uncertainty: Reports describe specific actions and allegations in sensitive circumstances; do not infer broader protest scale, intent, or causation beyond what the reporting attributes to Indecom and other named sources.
